top_signals.title: Bonds Traders Look to Hedge Risk of Fed Rate Cuts in 2027
top_signals.summary: Bond traders are looking to hedge the risk that the Federal Reserve pivots to cutting rates in 2027. The dovish wagers are at odds with recent moves in the Treasuries market, which saw yields on long-dated bonds climb to multiyear highs as a Fed on hold would keep inflation running above its target for longer. Bloomberg's Ven Ram has more. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Korea Yield Curve Steepest Since 2021 as Long-Bond Slump Deepens
top_signals.summary: The spread between South Korea’s three- and 10-year government bond yields has widened to the highest in nearly five years amid a global selloff in long-dated securities and expectations that Bank of Korea won’t raise interest rates aggressively.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: South Korea Exploring New Financial Hub Beyond Overcrowded Seoul
top_signals.summary: South Korea is looking to create a new financial center outside the capital Seoul, as the government moves to ease over-concentration in the greater metropolitan area, which is home to more than half the country’s population.
